title: Evaluate and Improve Agent Development Kit Agents
description: Complete the Evaluate and Improve Agent Development Kit Agents skill badge to demonstrate your ability to use ADK's evaluation tools to "hill climb", making measurable, iterative improvements to an agent. You will run an initial evaluation to establish a baseline, apply optimization techniques, and re-evaluate the agent to measure your success.

title: Accelerate Development with Antigravity
description: Complete the Accelerate Development with Antigravity skill badge to demonstrate your proficiency in using the Antigravity IDE for developing agentic workflows. You will be tasked with configuring an MCP server, authoring custom agent skills and rules, prototyping with the Agents CLI, and deploying to the Google Cloud Agent Runtime.

title: Deploy an Agent with Agent Development Kit (ADK)
description: Complete the Deploy an Agent with Agent Development Kit (ADK) skill badge to demonstrate your ability to author agents using Agent Development Kit (ADK), deploy those agents to Agent Engine, and call the hosted agent from a web app.

title: Claude Partner Badge - Claude Code
description: The Claude Partner Badge: Claude Code validates that consultants are ready to scope, deploy, configure, and run Claude Code activations end-to-end. The program consists of 8 courses covering each stage of a client engagement, combining practice exercises with real deliverables such as configuration packs, deployment decision docs, security questionnaires, custom commands, Skills, hooks, and telemetry configs. Candidates complete a scenario-based capstone assessment to earn the badge.

title: IBM Generative & Agentic AI Cybersecurity Engineer
description: The badge earner has experience designing, solutioning and/or delivering AI-powered cybersecurity services and solutions. They leverage AI to create client engagement work products and deliverables. They have experience working with watsonx or Strategic Partner generative AI products and functionality. They apply techniques and tools that mitigate risks and ethical concerns of AI, make use of IBM generative AI tools, assets, and methods in their day-to-day activities.

title: 2026 IBMer watsonx Challenge
description: The badge earner participated in the 2026 IBMer watsonx Challenge. This badge recognizes foundation-level competence in IBM Bob, an AI Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) partner. Badge holders may also have applied experience using IBM Consulting Advantage in the challenge. This badge signifies the individual’s knowledge of AI SDLC, their ability to apply that knowledge practically, and their potential to drive AI solution development.

title: Security for AI Essentials
description: The badge earner has demonstrated expertise in securing generative AI, enabling them to advise clients on protecting AI investments and building secure AI systems. This credential recognizes their ability to navigate AI security risks and communicate the value of secure AI development.

title: Digital Product Engineering Essentials
description: The badge earner is able to articulate what it means to have a Product Mindset, understand common product terminology, and recognize the difference and benefits of using a "product approach" over a "project approach". They understand what a product-led company looks like and how they can apply a Product Mindset to help our clients shift to being product-led. They understand how to work in a product squad delivery model and the characteristics that make a squad high-performing.

title: IBM Generative & Agentic AI Developer
description: The badge earner has experience developing AI-powered applications and solutions. They create development work products and deliverables to achieve solutions aligned with IBM's generative AI offerings; use watsonx or Strategic Partner generative AI products and functionality; and apply techniques and tools that mitigate risks and ethical concerns of AI. Earner makes use of IBM generative AI tools, assets, and methods.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enhanced AI Outputs
description: This credential earner has the practical skills to implement a document-based RAG system to enhance LLM responses and integrate dynamic knowledge sources to enhance RAG output quality. The individual can describe a RAG system workflow for content generation; apply best practices to improve RAG system outputs; distinguish between naive, advanced, and modular RAG implementation techniques; and apply best practices for overcoming RAG system challenges.

title: Bobathon Innovator
description: The badge earner has participated in the Bobathon, demonstrating skills and capabilities of an agile project team in alignment with teamwork & collaboration to create a prototype of an innovative, working solution to a given problem statement.

title: AWS Cloud Quest: Cloud Practitioner - Training Badge
description: Earners of this badge have demonstrated basic solution building knowledge using AWS services and have a fundamental understanding of AWS Cloud concepts. Badge earners have acquired hands-on experience with compute, networking, database and security services.
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification

title: Building RAG Apps Using MongoDB
description: This digital credential validates your knowledge in building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications with MongoDB. It recognizes your understanding of integrating vector search, optimizing retrieval workflows, and enhancing LLM-powered apps.

title: AWS Partner: Agentic AI Essentials - Training Badge
description: This course explores agentic AI solutions, advancing beyond generative AI fundamentals. By now, students know how agentic AI represents the convergence of distributed systems expertise with modern AI reasoning capabilities, building directly on the generative AI foundation they already understand.
issuer: Amazon Web Services Training and Certification

title: watsonx Orchestrate Technical Sales Intermediate
description: This badge earner demonstrates technical sales knowledge and skills for watsonx Orchestrate. They can discuss and persuasively position watsonx Orchestrate to clients. Additionally, they can deliver a compelling technical demonstration that combines multiple watsonx Orchestrate skills to support business scenarios utilizing pre-built skills, conversational AI and decision management.

title: IBM Generative & Agentic AI Foundation
description: The badge earner is able to competently engage in conversations with clients about generative and agentic AI technology, capabilities, value, risks, and ethical concerns. They are able to use the generative and agentic AI capabilities of IBM Consulting Advantage to be more productive and to create higher quality work products and client solutions.

title: Building AI-Powered Search with MongoDB Vector Search
description: This digital credential validates your knowledge in creating intelligent, AI-powered search experiences for applications using MongoDB Atlas Vector Search. It recognizes your understanding of indexing, embeddings, and retrieval strategies.

title: IBM Growth Behaviors
description: This badge earner understands and practices behaviors that foster a growth culture we all need in order to drive new ideas, collaboration, inclusion and speed that unleash our full potential and leads to growth. The IBM Growth Behaviors are Growth Minded, Trusted, Team Focused, Courageous, Resourceful and Outcome Focused.

title: 2025 IBMer watsonx Challenge
description: The badge earner participated in the 2025 IBMer watsonx Challenge. This badge recognizes foundation-level learning and competence in agentic AI using key products like watsonx Orchestrate and/or IBM Strategic Partner products. Badge holders may also have applied experience using IBM Consulting Advantage in the Challenge. This badge signifies the individual's knowledge of agentic AI, their ability to apply that knowledge practically, and their potential to drive agentic AI solution development.

title: IBM Delivery Central Platform Foundations
description: The badge earner has acquired foundational level knowledge of IBM Delivery Central Platform (IDCP) and can successfully use the platform for Project Execution / Management.

title: IBM Consulting Way Habits - Foundational
description: The earner of the IBM Consulting Way Badge understands the six habits of IBM Consulting and the importance of developing these habits and embedding them into their ways of working. This badge also signifies that its holder has explored and utilized the various resources IBM Consulting has in place to help IBMers succeed, such as Content+, Institute for Business Value (IBV), and Checkpoint.

title: IBM watsonx Essentials
description: This badge earner understands and can articulate the AI use cases where the IBM watsonx platform helps clients deploy and embed generative AI across their businesses, manage all data sources, and accelerate responsible AI workflows. In addition, the earner understands the concepts and advantages of AI, along with IBM's AI strategy for addressing ethical and sustainable AI challenges.

title: Energy, Environment and Utilities Industry Jumpstart
description: This badge is awarded for successful completion of the Industry Jumpstart program

title: JavaScript Full Stack Development
description: The badge earner is able to develop develop end-to-end Web Applications across front-end and back-end application stacks

title: IBM Garage Essentials
description: This badge earner is able to demonstrate understanding of IBM Garage Methodology, assets and platforms.

title: IBM Garage Foundation
description: This badge earner has gained a basic understanding and skill necessary to perform in an IBM Garage engagement.

title: Enterprise Design Thinking Practitioner
description: The earner has acquired knowledge of applying Enterprise Design Thinking and its value. As a Practitioner, the badge earner finds opportunities to try it out in their every day work.

title: JavaScript Front End Development
description: The badge earner is able to develop Front End JavaScript-based Single Page and progressive Web applications.

title: IBM Agile Explorer
description: The Agile Explorer has a foundational understanding of Agile values, principles, and practices that allows them to initiate an Agile conversation with co-workers and colleagues. This badge is available to IBM employees only.
